review_candidates.description: Dashiell, an operating unit of Quanta Services (trading as PWR), is a leading national provider of technical and construction services supporting critical electric infrastructure. We serve electric utilities, power generation, industrial, renewable, and energy markets with integrated capabilities spanning planning and system studies, engineering and design, maintenance and testing, program management, construction, and turnkey EPC delivery. With more than 60 years of experience executing large, complex projects, Dashiell specializes in medium- and high-voltage electrical infrastructure and delivers safe, reliable solutions across the full project lifecycle. Backed by the scale, resources, and safety culture of Quanta Services, Dashiell partners with clients to build and maintain the infrastructure that powers communities and economies. Learn more at www.dashiell.com. Primary Function Dashiell Corporation is seeking qualified candidates for its IT Support Specialist team in Houston, Texas. This posting covers three levels of the IT Support Specialist role — Level I, Level II, and Level III — with final placement determined based on each candidate’s qualifications, experience, and demonstrated technical competency during the selection process. All levels are based in our Houston, Texas office located at 12301 Kurland Drive, Suite 400, Houston, Texas 77034 and will report to Dashiell’s IT Manager. IT Support Specialists at Dashiell provide hands-on technical support across the organization, ensuring employees at all levels have reliable, responsive access to the hardware, software, and systems they need to do their best work. As an EPC firm supporting critical electrical infrastructure projects, we depend on a capable, responsive IT support team to keep operations running smoothly across our corporate offices and field environments. Role Level Summary Candidates will be placed into one of the following levels based on their experience and qualifications: IT Support Specialist I — Entry level. No prior professional IT experience required. Focuses on first-contact helpdesk support, workstation setup, and basic troubleshooting under direct supervision. IT Support Specialist II — Experienced. Minimum 2 years’ corporate IT support experience required. Independently resolves intermediate and escalated tickets; supports infrastructure maintenance and mentors Level I staff. IT Support Specialist III — Senior. Minimum 5 years’ corporate IT support experience required. Serves as the top-tier escalation point; leads initiatives, mentors all junior staff, and contributes to infrastructure stability and continuous improvement. Duties & Responsibilities Employee May Be Called Upon To Perform Any Or All Of The Following Functions, With Scope And Complexity Increasing By Level Respond to and resolve helpdesk tickets in a timely and professional manner, including password resets, account access issues, common application errors, and escalated technical problems (complexity increases with level). Install, configure, and troubleshoot desktop and laptop workstations, printers, mobile devices, and peripherals across single or multiple office locations. Support user account administration including Active Directory, group policy application, and email systems (Level II and above). Troubleshoot network connectivity, VPN access, and basic infrastructure components including switches, access points, and cabling as directed by senior staff (Level II and above). Lead workstation imaging, software deployment, and hardware refresh initiatives as directed by the IT Manager (Level III). Administer and maintain Microsoft 365 environments, security permissions, and group policies (Level III). Identify recurring technical issues and recommend process improvements, knowledge base articles, or user training to reduce future ticket volume (Level III). Provide mentorship and technical guidance to junior IT Support Specialist staff on troubleshooting methodology, ticket documentation standards, and customer communication (Level II and above). Support remote and regional office locations onsite or via remote access tools; travel to field or project sites as needed. Maintain accurate records of all support activities, resolutions, and asset information in the helpdesk ticketing system. Assist senior IT staff with security patching, backup verification, system monitoring, and disaster recovery testing as directed (Level III). Communicate clearly with end users at all levels to diagnose issues and explain resolutions in non-technical terms. Provide after-hours support as business needs require. Perform special projects and complete other duties as assigned or requested. How You Will Make An Impact Minimize employee downtime by providing prompt, high-quality resolution of technical issues at the appropriate level of complexity. Improve end-user productivity through reliable hardware, software, and network support and responsive customer service. Strengthen the IT team’s capabilities through mentorship, knowledge sharing, and consistent documentation practices. Contribute to a stable, secure, and well-maintained IT environment that supports Dashiell’s EPC project delivery and corporate operations. Build organizational trust by delivering dependable, professional technical support to every employee. Minimum Qualifications / Experience Qualifications vary by level. Candidates should apply if they meet the requirements for any of the three levels described below. IT Support Specialist I — Entry Level High school diploma or GED required; Associate’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or related field preferred (2+ years equivalent professional experience considered in lieu). No prior professional IT experience required; internship, academic lab, or help desk experience a plus. Basic understanding of Windows 10/11 and common desktop/application concepts. Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (Outlook, Word, Excel). CompTIA A+ certification preferred but not required. Outstanding customer service skills; detail-oriented; self-motivated team player with eagerness to learn. IT Support Specialist II — Experienced Associate’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or related field required; Bachelor’s degree preferred (4+ years equivalent professional experience considered in lieu). Minimum of 2 years of experience in IT helpdesk or end-user technical support in a corporate environment. Solid working knowledge of Windows 10/11, Active Directory, and standard business applications. Experience troubleshooting network connectivity, VPN, and basic infrastructure components. CompTIA A+ certification required; CompTIA Network+ preferred. Experience with IT ticketing/asset management tools (e.g., ServiceNow, Jira, Freshdesk) preferred. Strong organizational, problem-solving, and communication skills. IT Support Specialist III — Senior Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or related field required (4+ years equivalent professional experience considered in lieu). Minimum of 5 years of experience in IT helpdesk or end-user technical support in a corporate environment. Advanced knowledge of Windows desktop and server operating systems, Active Directory, group policy management, and Microsoft 365 administration. Demonstrated experience troubleshooting complex network, VPN, and infrastructure component issues. CompTIA A+ and Network+ certifications required; CompTIA Security+, Microsoft certifications (MS-900, MD-102, AZ-900), or ITIL Foundation preferred. Experience with endpoint management solutions (e.g., Intune, SCCM), remote monitoring tools, or IT asset management platforms preferred. Familiarity with server administration, virtualization (VMware, Hyper-V), or cloud services (Azure, AWS) preferred. Demonstrated ability to mentor junior IT support staff; strong written and verbal communication skills. Experience supporting a multi-office or field-based workforce in construction, engineering, or industrial environments preferred. Physical Requirements Ability to sit for extended periods during computer-based work. Ability to stand and walk intermittently throughout the workday. Occasional lifting of up to 20 pounds (e.g., equipment boxes, monitors, peripherals). Occasional travel to other offices or field locations for equipment deployment or on-site support. Environmental Conditions Primarily climate-controlled office environment. Occasional exposure to field or industrial environments during site visits. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions as defined by Company policy. Equal Employment Opportunity Dashiell is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, religion, color, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected status under applicable law. Dashiell offers a competitive compensation and benefits package. Benefits include company-paid life insurance, accidental death and dismemberment insurance, long-term disability insurance, and an employee assistance program. Additional benefit offerings include medical coverage through a traditional PPO or one of two high-deductible health plans (with FSA or HSA options), dental and vision coverage, supplemental life insurance, short-term disability, critical illness insurance, group accident insurance, hospital indemnity insurance, and a 401(k) plan with immediate vesting, among others. Candidates must be at least 18 years of age and legally authorized to work in the United States on a permanent basis without current or future visa sponsorship. Third-party recruiters and agencies, please do not contact us regarding this position.

review_candidates.title: Solution Architect - Networking & Security
review_candidates.description: Solution Architect - Networking & Security Shoreham-by-Sea Flexible hybrid Up to £80,000 (Internal Job Level Reference{{:}} Senior Specialist) Focus Group is a £300m-revenue, 1,400-person technology services company backed by Hg Capital. Following our $1bn valuation in 2024, we're scaling rapidly and investing in AI to transform how we operate and how we serve our 30,000 SME customers. As we continue to expand our portfolio through acquisition and organic growth, we're committed to setting new industry standards in managed service excellence. About the role Our Networking and Security team is looking for a Solution Architect to own the technical design of complex customer projects across our SD-WAN (Software-Defined Wide Area Network), SASE (Secure Access Service Edge), firewall and routing/switching portfolio - and to stay hands-on all the way through delivery. This isn't a role where you hand off a design and move on. You'll translate customer requirements into High-Level and Low-Level Designs, act as design authority on your own projects, and then work alongside our delivery engineers to build, migrate and commission the solutions you've designed - both remotely and on customer sites. It's a genuine blend of architecture and hands-on delivery, with UK site travel and some planned out-of-hours work for change windows. What you'll be doing Owning the end-to-end technical design of multi-site networking and security projects, from pre-sales and solution design right through to customer hand-over Staying hands-on through delivery{{:}} personally carrying out configuration, build, migration and commissioning of Cisco, Fortinet and adjacent platforms alongside the delivery team Travelling to customer sites across the UK to lead design workshops, attend kick-offs, run surveys, and complete installation, cabling and commissioning work where needed Producing High-Level and Low-Level Designs, build documents, configuration templates, runbooks and as-built hand-over packs to a customer-facing standard Turning customer requirements and commercial outcomes into deliverable architectures, refining designs as real-world project realities emerge Reviewing engineer-produced configurations, change records and build documents to own the technical quality of everything that reaches the customer Leading and mentoring delivery engineers on projects, supporting their certification paths and development Acting as the senior technical escalation point during build, migration and cut-over phases Explaining design decisions, progress, risks and trade-offs to customers in clear, plain language - no unnecessary jargon Leading pre-sales solution design, using your Cisco and Fortinet expertise to shape and pressure-test proposed approaches Helping set and improve the design and build standards the wider team works to What you'll bring CCNP (Cisco Certified Network Professional) as a minimum Hands-on experience designing, configuring and deploying Fortinet platforms (FortiGate, FortiManager, FortiAnalyzer and the wider Security Fabric) in production environments - NSE 4 or higher preferred Practical experience delivering SSE or SASE technology (for example Cisco Secure Access, Cisco Plus Secure Connect, FortiSASE, Zscaler, Netskope or Cato) Strong design and delivery experience on at least one major SD-WAN platform (Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN/Viptela, Meraki SD-WAN, Fortinet Secure SD-WAN or comparable) Solid working knowledge across networking fundamentals{{:}} routing and switching, VLANs, BGP, OSPF, IPsec, QoS, DNS, DHCP and wireless A track record of delivering multi-site network and security projects end to end, from design through to hand-over Hands-on, on-site implementation experience, including UK travel and physical installation work Confident written and verbal communication - able to explain technical decisions and trade-offs to customers and non-technical stakeholders alike A calm, methodical approach under pressure, particularly during cut-overs and migrations A full UK driving licence, as the role involves regular travel to customer sites Nice to have Fortinet NSE 6 or NSE 7 Wider Cisco specialisations (Meraki, Umbrella, Duo, ISE or ThousandEyes) Experience with HP/Aruba or SonicWall Public cloud networking experience (Azure and/or AWS) Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) design experience Experience defining technical standards or reference architectures for a delivery team Ambition to grow into a Lead or Principal Solution Architect role over time Why Focus Group You'll be joining a business that provides essential technology and support so our customers can focus on growing theirs - and we take the same approach with our people. This is a role with real ownership{{:}} you design it, you help build it, and you see it through to a customer standing on a solution that works. You'll work alongside experienced engineers and architects, with support for further certifications and a clear path to progress your career. We offer a competitive salary of up to £80,000, depending on experience, along with flexible hybrid working based out of our Shoreham-by-Sea office. If you're a networking and security specialist who wants to stay close to the tools as well as the whiteboard, we'd love to hear from you.

review_candidates.title: Systems Engineer - Mid
review_candidates.description: With a company culture rooted in collaboration, expertise and innovation, we aim to promote progress and inspire our clients, employees, investors and communities to achieve their greatest potential. Our work is the catalyst that helps others achieve their goals. In short, We Enable Possibility℠. Strategic Analytics is a growing team at Arch that develops predictive models, analytical tools, and automations to improve profitability and growth. This role supports the technical infrastructure behind those efforts. As a System Engineer, you will manage and optimize cloud data platforms — primarily Snowflake and Databricks — ensuring availability, performance, security, and cost efficiency. You’ll support enterprise analytics and AI/ML workloads, drive automation and operational excellence, and collaborate with Strategic Analytics architects, engineers, and global teams. Experience with Azure SQL and related Azure services is a plus. The team’s technology needs evolve, so a willingness to learn and adopt new tools is essential. Tasks/Responsibilities Manage and optimize Snowflake and Databricks environments, including performance tuning, cost controls, workload isolation, and scaling; provide secondary support for Azure SQL and Azure Data Factory. Build and maintain data pipelines using Databricks, Snowflake Streams/Tasks, and Azure Data Factory. Enforce security and governance controls including RBAC, encryption, auditing, masking, lineage, and Entra ID (Azure AD) integration. Tune queries and workloads using native tools such as Snowflake Query Profile, Databricks SQL Analytics, and Azure Monitor. Implement and maintain disaster recovery, replication, backup, and archival strategies across platforms. Collaborate with data engineers, data scientists, BI teams, and architects to support scalable data models, integrations, and reporting. Provide production support, incident response, and root-cause analysis for data platform issues. Evaluate and adopt new platform features (e.g., Snowflake Native Apps, Databricks Unity Catalog) to improve governance and automation. Required Skills/Experience Hands-on Snowflake administration: warehouse management, query tuning, clustering, caching, cost governance, Time Travel, and replication. Hands-on Databricks administration: workspaces, clusters, SQL Warehouses, jobs, policies, and workload isolation. Experience with Databricks Unity Catalog, data governance, lineage, and access controls. Proficiency in SQL and scripting with Python and/or PowerShell. Experience with Azure data services (Data Factory, Databricks, Azure SQL), including connectivity, authentication, and monitoring. Strong understanding of platform security: RBAC, encryption, auditing, masking, and Entra ID integration. Experience with backup, recovery, and DR strategies including Snowflake replication and Time Travel. Proven production support skills with ability to resolve complex, cross-platform incidents. Familiarity with CI/CD and DevOps practices for data platform deployments. Solid documentation skills — SOPs, runbooks, architecture diagrams, and DR plans. Clear communicator who works well with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Awareness of AI services relevant to platform administration. Education BS in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or equivalent practical experience (typically 5–7+ years) in data platforms, database administration, or software engineering. Do you like solving complex business problems, working with talented colleagues and have an innovative mindset? Arch may be a great fit for you. If this job isn’t the right fit but you’re interested in working for Arch, create a job alert! Simply create an account and opt in to receive emails when we have job openings that meet your criteria. Join our talent community to share your preferences directly with Arch’s Talent Acquisition team. 10400 Arch Global Services (Philippines) Inc.
